Plot distribution of annual event totals

Source: R/hazard_viz.R
plot_annual_counts.Rd

Computes annual totals from daily event flags and plots a histogram of either distinct events or event-days.

Usage

plot_annual_counts(daily, metric = c("events", "days"), show_poisson = TRUE)

Arguments

daily

A data frame or tibble with columns sim_year and event_id (NA means no event that day).

metric

Character scalar; one of "events" or "days".

show_poisson

Logical scalar; if TRUE, add Poisson expected points for the "events" metric.

Value

A ggplot object.

Details

Annual n_events counts distinct non-NA event_id values per sim_year; annual n_days counts daily rows with non-NA event_id. A Poisson expected-count overlay is added only when metric = "events" and show_poisson = TRUE.

Examples

d <- data.frame(
  sim_year = rep(2001:2003, each = 5),
  event_id = c(NA, 1, 1, NA, 2, NA, NA, 3, 3, 3, NA, 4, NA, 5, NA)
)
plot_annual_counts(d, metric = "events")
